summary: Vertical pingpong extension: output height = 4*(h-1)+1 (two full zigzag periods of 2*(h-1)), output width = input width. Output row i copies input row pos when pos = i mod 2*(h-1) is <= h-1, else input row 2*(h-1)-pos (reflection). Pure geometric rule on dotted-lattice inputs: sparse 1-2 color short-period marks on a 0 background.
